name: Earthquake

outcomes.criticalSuccess: The creature takes half the collapse damage.
outcomes.success: The creature takes half the collapse damage and falls prone.
outcomes.failure: The creature takes the full collapse damage and falls prone.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The creature takes the full collapse damage and falls into a fissure.

heightening.text: You create a massive earthquake that can devastate a settlement. The range increases to half a mile and the area to a quarter-mile burst.

entries: You shake the ground, topple creatures into fissures, and collapse structures.
The GM might add additional effects in certain areas. Cliffs might collapse, causing creatures to fall, or a lake might drain as fissures open up below its surface, leaving a morass of quicksand.
